answer: An ivory hollow beacon heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each agent holds one post at a hollow ivory relay, sealed with a sable key, and must answer a random beacon challenge with a heartbeat each epoch. A missed or copied heartbeat burns its bond. First fake costs 60; the k-th 60+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,057,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-heartbeat ring fails: one sable seal answers one challenge. An honest agent pays 60 once.
